ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the lines $AB$ and $CD$ intersect at point O, and $OE \perp CD$ at O. $OD$ bisects $\angle AOF$, and $\angle AOE = 55^\circ$. What is the degree measure of $\angle BOF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} According to the construction,\\
since $OE \perp CD$ and $\angle AOE = 55^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOD = 90^\circ - \angle AOE = 35^\circ$,\\
since $OD$ bisects $\angle AOF$,\\
it yields $\angle DOF = \angle AOD = 35^\circ$,\\
since lines $AB$ and $CD$ intersect at point O,\\
thus $\angle BOC = \angle AOD = 35^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle BOF = 180^\circ - \angle BOC - \angle DOF = \boxed{110^\circ}$.
